::: {.incremental}

## The SoIB Partnership {background-image="pics/soib_logo.png" background-size="10%" background-position="top right"}

- Provide **best current knowledge** on status and conservation of India's birds
- **Curating, analysing, and synthesizing available information** to bring out **variety of knowledge products** for use by policymakers, managers, researchers, conservationists, media, and other stakeholders
- Products **freely available**, and represent **state-of-the-art knowledge** on species, habitats, locations, and threats

![](pics/foss_meme.jpg){fig-align="center" height=250}

# Data-driven research & conservation policy {.section-slide background-color="#d9d2b8"}

## {background-color="black"}

:::{.notes}
but where do we start?
:::

## 

![](pics/ebird_status_trends.png){fig-align="center" height=400}

:::{.fragment}
Developed a new methodological framework
:::

:::{.notes}
Great knowledge product at high resolution. But very fine-scale spatially explicit results, whereas we wanted regional-level assessments, where national and state-level policy is managed. It also involves some degree of extrapolation which we wanted to avoid (involves relationships with habitat and other variables, which are used to predict/extrapolate for cells without data)
:::

## 

:::: {.r-stack}

::: {layout-ncol=2 height=400}

![](pics/soib2020-cover.png){style="box-shadow: 0 4px 10px rgba(0,0,0,0.3); padding: 0px; border: 1px solid #ddd; border-radius: 10px;"}

![](pics/soib2023-cover.png){style="box-shadow: 0 4px 10px rgba(0,0,0,0.3); padding: 0px; border: 1px solid #ddd; border-radius: 10px;"}

:::

![](pics/viswanathanetal2025.png){fig-align="center" height=400 .fragment}

::::

:::{.notes}
the main eBird analytical framework that produced status & trends assessments was published in detail with the hope that it serves as a blueprint for other regions looking to produce SoB
:::

## {background-image="pics/soib_pipeline.jpg" background-position="right" background-color="white" background-size="contain"}

::: {.fragment}
- Data curation before modelling
- List length covariate: utilise historical data
- Spatial subsampling + nested random effects in GLMMs
- Strict sensitivity checks
- Three-way conservation priority classification
:::

:::{.notes}
Reshaping (effort, spatial-temporal units, vagrant records) & curation (reviewing checklist completeness)---we found to have big impact on results
:::

## The knowledge gap {visibility="uncounted"}

<!-- drop if no time -->

- National + state-wise  products & launches
- Engagement with state- and local-level stakeholders (FD training)
- IUCN Red List reassessment of 9 species
- National Red List
- Proactive partnership of organisations

## SoIB 2027 sneak peek! {visibility="uncounted"}

- Analytical improvements: subsampling, checklist centroids, hex-grids
- Data improvements: species attributes
- Data gaps: species, space, habitat, scale ?
- Conservation across space: habitats, protection, urbanisation
- Metrics for conservation: NRL, WPE, WLPA, Wild Bird Index ?
- Demography
- Deeper dives: threats & policy
- ... and more!
